description: Fictional incoming replies with human-authored ground-truth labels. The held_out split is reserved and was not used to tune prompts or model outputs.

replies.text: This sounds relevant to the way our support group hands cases between shifts. Please send a short overview and I can take a look.
Could we find twenty minutes next week? I would like to understand how the handoff board works.
Thanks for reaching out. We already have a process that works for our team, so we will pass.
Appreciate the note. We are not considering a change this quarter; perhaps check back later in the year.
I am away through December 3. For the maintenance schedule, Mira in plant operations is the right person to contact.
I do not own our support workflow. Please try Rowan, who leads customer operations.
Please remove me from future outreach and do not contact this address again.
Does the product work for a team that keeps its equipment records on a local network?
I received your message, but I am not sure why it was sent to this shared mailbox.
We have been reviewing our shift notes. I would be open to seeing a brief example using fictional records.
We are not evaluating new systems and have no budget for this. I am curious what one small workshop would pay, though.
Please send two times that work for you on Thursday or Friday.
I am out of the office until Monday and will reply after I return. For urgent maintenance questions, contact the duty supervisor.
We are not planning a purchase now. Before I close this out, is there a way to export the checklist?
Thanks for the follow-up. We will not be making a change, and I do not need more information.
This belongs with our facilities coordinator, not the finance team. I have forwarded your note internally.
Stop emailing me. I do not consent to further messages.
Your message refers to a support queue, but our team does not use that term. I cannot tell what you are proposing.
The maintenance notes are relevant. Could you share the setup steps and any limitations for a small team?
I am away until Friday. Please contact Jo in operations while I am out; she can route the request.
